svg.title: eCQM Copilot — end-to-end architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture diagram from FHIR ingest through RAG extraction, safety validation, clinician review, and reporting with a learning loop.

g.text: Bundle hash + validation · PHI guard / de-ID · provenance seed (who/what/when/source)
FHIR: Patient · Encounter · Condition · Observation · MedRequest · DocumentReference
Feature registry · DocumentReference note fetch · context pack (structured facts + note snippets)
Rule validators (type / temporal / unit) · hallucination guard (must-have evidence span) · PHI check
Fail → route to reviewer without auto-suggest · Pass → draft decision object
GET /cases/{id} · accept / reject / edit · rationale · override delta + time-to-decision captured
MeasureReport + Provenance (FHIR) · audit trail · S3 / SFTP / FHIR endpoint export
